count_pages.code:
const response = await client.pages.countPages({active: true, has_layout: true});
console.log(response.map.total);

head_page.code:
const response = await client.pages.headPage(812);
console.log(response.statusCode, response.headers.etag);

patch_page.code:
const response = await client.pages.patchPage(812, {page: {title: 'About our company'}});
console.log(response.map.page.title, response.map.page.updated_at);

update_page_url.code:
const response = await client.pages.updatePageUrl(812, {url: 'about-our-company'});
console.log(response.map.page.url, response.map.page.full_url);

set_landing_page.code:
const response = await client.pages.setLandingPage(812);
console.log(response.map.page.id, response.map.page.landing);

duplicate_page.code:
const response = await client.pages.duplicatePage(812);
console.log(response.map.page.id, response.map.page.name, response.map.page.url);
